recipe_inventory.label: Hydrazine-assisted hydrothermal Jaipurite preparation

source_locators.locator: Main PDF p. 1 (printed p. 36), Abstract and Experimental
Main PDF p. 3 (printed p. 38), Figure 3, Results and Discussion, Conclusions

recipe_inventory.scope: 100 mL 0.1 M analytical-grade sodium sulfide solution mixed with an equivalent cobalt acetate solution; amorphous black slurry filtered/washed several times; wet slurry, 6 mL analytical hydrazine monohydrate and water up to 85% total volume in a 100 mL Teflon-lined autoclave; 120 °C/24 h; natural cooling; filter/wash several times; vacuum box 80 °C/4 h. Separately, 1.4 kmol m−3 hydrazine is named as optimum.
gaps: Cobalt acetate hydration/formulation, solution amount/concentration and meaning of “equivalent” are unspecified.
No pressure, closure, ramp, stirring, exact water amount, wash count/volume, vacuum level or yield.
No unique physical batch IDs, sample-matched coordinates, CIF or TEM-derived numeric dimensions.

recipe_inventory.scope: Simple hydrothermal treatment of amorphous CoS without hydrazine; article says no other conditions changed and amorphous product occurs across stated pH 1.0–14.0. Range is not assigned one sample per pH.
gaps: Control-specific water replacement/fill and exact per-sample pH conditions are not stated.

recipe_inventory.label: Ammonia substitution comparison

source_locators.locator: Main PDF p. 2 (printed p. 37), Figure 1c caption
Main PDF p. 3 (printed p. 38), Figure 3a caption and Results and Discussion

recipe_inventory.scope: Caption states 1.4 kmol m−3 NH3 and 120 °C. Unidentified compound; no Jaipurite phase. The authors suggest a stable NH3-coordinated complex; ammonium is reported confirmed by IR.
gaps: No dwell, batch ID, product formula or coordination geometry is supplied; do not inherit the main 24 h as a stated caption condition.

characterization_inventory.label: XRD phase assignment and Table 1
characterization_inventory.scope: Hexagonal β-CoS Jaipurite, NiAs type; all peaks indexed; no CoO/other cobalt sulfide detected; a=3.352 Å, c=5.138 Å, c/a=1.532; about 20 nm XRD/Scherrer mean; seven table rows transcribed as printed.

characterization_inventory.label: TEM morphology
characterization_inventory.scope: Laminar/lamellar; some particles stack; Figure 2 scale bar 100 nm, no numeric TEM dimensions.

characterization_inventory.label: Chemical composition
characterization_inventory.scope: Chemical analysis Co/S atomic ratio 1.009; described as approximately stoichiometric and slightly sulfur-deficient.

characterization_inventory.label: IR and post-mineralization solution observations
characterization_inventory.scope: No hydrazine absorption noted in Figure 3b; ammonium reported confirmed in Figure 3a; solution reportedly retained reductivity by a KMnO4 method.

characterization_inventory.label: Additive and precursor concentration comparisons
characterization_inventory.scope: Ethylenediamine: no XRD phase detected; below 1.1 kmol m−3 hydrazine: no crystalline Jaipurite; precursor-ion concentration 0.01–1 M: no considerable size effect reported. Sample/run assignments incomplete.
